title: MENA-RTD release-clock schema

fields.release_type: Flash, preliminary, full release, revision, catalogue publication, etc.
fields.observed_public_date: Date the release was observed publicly
fields.formal_catalog_date: Date assigned by the statistical agency catalogue/archive when available
fields.reported_value: Value in the source where captured

rules: Never collapse flash and full releases into one release object.
Preserve conflicting official dates rather than choosing silently.
A formal catalogue date is not automatically the first date economic information was publicly available.
All derived latency metrics must declare the release-type clock used.
